rationale: Optimal dispatch minimizes diesel active power to reduce fuel cost (76/MWh), setting p_diesel=14 MW (minimum feasible given inverter Pmax=20 MW and load=34 MW). q_diesel set to preferred value 4 Mvar to avoid deviation penalty. Inverter operates at P=20 MW, Q=8 Mvar within apparent power limit (sqrt(20^2+8^2)=21.54 MVA <= 24 MVA). Voltage=0.965+0.0025*(4+8)=0.995 pu.
